entries.notes: priorities are pressing now - money is being raised to expedite the negotiations and be on the land within 30 days. We are a non-profit association and any donation is tax-exempt. Send any contributions to: Sisters of Diana, Inc., RR1, Box 42A, Tishingo, OK, 73460. Loan contracts also honored.

entries.land_description: There's a small cabin but women interested in joining them need to build their own sleeping structure and help with land payments. They are hoping that dykes will buy the land adjacent to them that is for sale for $17,000 ($3,400 down).
entries.welcomed_groups: Dykes passing through northern California are welcome to visit.

entries.land_description: 25 miles southeast of Tucson that a woman has bought to be used by any woman interested. There is space for women and children to rent (there is an A-frame and plenty of land to camp on) on a nightly or monthly basis.
entries.notes: They need a lot of financial support so for every $2 a woman donates, she is entitled to one free night of camping available any time in her life. In return for a donation they will send information and directions. Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope to Cave Canyon Ranch, PO Box D-11, Vail, AZ, 85641.

entries.land_description: are "squatting" on a farm in Massachusetts. They have been told to leave but they are hanging on.
entries.notes: They want the space for women - no men. They need women to stay with them indefinitely for this action; also financial support. Sorry we don't have all the information about this, but write to the Ashfield Farm Women, Samson Road Farm, Samson Rd., Ashfield, MA 01330.

entries.land_description: is a feminist country retreat. It is run by a collective of five women who open their house for workshops to women seeking more about themselves and their lives.
entries.notes: They say, "we feel that living with each other in the country has helped us to become stronger, healthier, more centered, and more creative. Some of the things we have been dealing with are our feminist politics, our sexuality and our own creativity. We know that we need contact with other women and we also need a way to survive economically in the country. Womanshare is our way of doing this." Fees are on a sliding scale from $10 to $15 per day. Scholarships are available and child care is negotiable. Include partial payment ($10) when you register. The Womanshare Collective says, "we would like you to come and relax, join in discussion groups and workshops, enjoy good home-cooked food, and get to know us. We feel that being in the country, having a good time with other women can be a very high experience." For more information, write Womanshare, 1531 Gray's Creek Road, Grants Pass, OR, 97526. Thanks to RUNES for this info.

entries.acreage: ten pasture acres ... and access to 90 wooded acres for hiking
entries.land_description: is a place in the country for women to get in touch with our many ways of doing things. It is a special place where women may come together away from the daily hassles of the patriarchal society and experience the strength of a woman's culture. It is not a resort. Each woman who comes to the land makes a commitment to herself and other women thereby accepting responsibility for herself, as well as by respecting and supporting other sisters who are there. Womens Ways is located in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York. There is a large A-frame house built solely by women. There are ten pasture acres for camping and access to 90 wooded acres for hiking. At present there are two permanent residents. As for accomodations, it is possible to rent the A-frame on a nightly ($3.50 - $5) or monthly ($70.00 plus utilities) basis. Camping is available for $2.50 a night or $40.00 a month and access to the house and utilities is available. Work exchanges are also available, as there is never a lack of projects around.
entries.notes: Write or call for reservations or information: Women's Ways, Andrews/Mulholland, RD1, Box 375A, Craryville, NY, 12521.- Phone 518 385-6612.

entries.land_description: began in September, 1974 when seven women pooled their resources, purchased a former mountain resort, and established a woman's collective dedicated to the support of a retreat for all women. A Woman's Place is situated on 23 acres in the Adirondacks; there is a main house where the collective women and their children live, four large nearby cabins and a recreation facility.
entries.welcomed_groups: Women are welcome to come for a day, a week, or a month, and A Woman's Place can also be reserved for groups of up to 30 women.
entries.notes: The rates are on a sliding scale of $10 to $25 a day. Due to reservation demands, A Woman's Place needs a definite commitment on specific dates. Along with your reservations, please send a small deposit. Write to Mary Deyoe, A Woman's Place, Athol, NY, 12810 - Phone 518 623-9541.

entries.land_description: For lesbians who are interested in country living, or passing thru and need a mellow atmosphere to stay in. We live in a 18' tipi on 78 acres with trees, hay, animals and the Elwha River running through the back meadow. The property is owned by the gay community of Seattle and presently has 3 faggots living in the up front houses, and we are back near the forest land. The land is for lesbians and faggots, however more lesbians would be nice and the men here would rather turn the total 78 over to the dykes.
entries.welcomed_groups: For lesbians ... passing thru ... The land is for lesbians and faggots, however more lesbians would be nice
